title: Concept: Directory listing enabled in the server configuration in nginx — review required
description: In nginx, directory listing is enabled. Without an index file the server enumerates everything in the directory, including temporary files and copies left by editors or deployment scripts. Those names are exactly what an attacker needs to turn a guessing attack into a direct download.
applicability: nginx web servers that serve static directories.
risk: Exposure of unlinked and temporary files; LOW severity.
